title: Pip and the Sleepy Chrysalis
moral: Good things take time, so we wait with patient, kind hearts.
description: Pip finds a sparkly green chrysalis in Nana Hoot's garden and wants the butterfly to come out RIGHT NOW! A bonk, a wake-up song and one giant sneeze later, can Pip learn to wait? Learn the seven days of the week, from Monday to Sunday, in this funny animated story about patience for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? On Monday morning, Pip found something super strange in Nana Hoot's garden!
A little green bundle was hanging from a twig. It had shiny gold dots!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana! Nana! What is it? Is it a chrysa-lolly-pop?

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! It's a chrysalis, Pip. A caterpillar is inside, changing into a butterfly!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: A butterfly? Super-duper! Will it come out in one minute?

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Oh no, dear. It takes lots of days. We must be patient.
Monday went by. Then came the next day. Which day comes after Monday?
Tuesday! Yes! You're so smart!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Knock, knock! Butterfly, are you ready yet?
Pip tapped the twig. BOING! It sprang right back and BONK! Right on his nose!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! Pip, I don't think butterflies answer the door!
On Wednesday, Pip had a new plan. A great big wake-up song!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Wakey, wakey, butterfly! La-la-LAAAA!
The chrysalis did not wake up. But somebody else fell fast asleep... Nana Hoot! Zzzzz.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! I'm awake! Oh dear, my glasses slipped again.
Hee-hee! Still no butterfly.
Thursday! Try number three. Tumble flapped his big ears like fans. Flap, flap, flap!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: A breeze will tickle it awake! Oh... oh... AH-CHOOOO!
Whoooosh! The giant sneeze spun Pip round and round and round!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I'm a dizzy-whizzy fox! Why won't it hurry up?
The chrysalis just swayed gently. Swing, swing. Safe and snug.
On Friday, Pip felt grumpy. He stomped and huffed. Hmmph!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Pip, waiting is easier when we keep busy. Let's plant flowers for the butterfly!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ooh! Butterflies love flowers! Super-duper idea, Hazel!
So they planted one, two, three rows of seeds. Tumble watered them with his trunk. SPLOOSH! Oops, all over Hazel!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: BOING! went her prickles. Tee-hee-hee! That tickles!
Then came Saturday. Pitter-patter, pitter-patter! Rain began to fall.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Oh no! The little chrysalis will get all wet!
So Pip held a big leaf over it, like an umbrella. He waited, and waited, and waited.
Tumble held up his floppy ears like two umbrellas too!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Look at us, Pip! We're the waiting team!

popups.sub: the last day of the week

narration.text: That night, Pip didn't want to go home. He curled up right beside the twig.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Sweet dreams, my patient little fox. Hoo-hoo.
Saturday is almost over, friends. What day comes after Saturday?
Sunday! Ding! The very last day of the week!
Sunday morning! Wiggle, wiggle... crack! Something was coming out!
Out came a butterfly with orange and purple wings! Her wings were crumpled and wet.

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Shhh. Her wings need time to dry. Let's wait quietly.
This time, Pip waited super quietly. Then... flutter, flutter! She landed right on Tumble's trunk!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Hee-hee, it tickles! HONK! Oopsie-trunk!
Let's remember! On which day did Pip find the chrysalis?
Monday! The very first day of the week!
And how many days are in one week? Count them with me!
Seven! Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Seven days! Super-duper! I'm going to zip through them all!
Now the butterfly visits Pip's flowers every single day.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Waiting was hard. But it was super-duper worth it!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Good things take time, Pip. And you waited with a kind heart. Hoo-hoo-HOO!
So everybody did a happy butterfly dance. Flap, flap, wiggle, wiggle!
